name: resizable-workspace-shell
title: ResizableWorkspaceShellBlock
description: Source-owned resizable workspace shell with a left rail, main work surface, and inspector panel.

meta.fileTree: Installs resizable-workspace-shell.tsx as user-owned source under src/components/blocks/resizable-workspace-shell.tsx.
meta.api: ResizableWorkspaceShellBlock accepts optional title, description, initialLeftWidth, initialInspectorWidth, min/max width constraints, class, and replacement slots for leftRail, workSurface, and inspector content.
meta.layout: Desktop uses a five-track CSS grid: left rail, left resize handle, main work surface, inspector resize handle, and inspector panel. Mobile/tablet widths collapse to a single-column document flow with rail, work surface, and inspector stacked in source order.
meta.keyboardReachability: Both resize handles are focusable role=separator buttons with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow, aria-valuetext, and aria-orientation. ArrowLeft/ArrowRight resize by 16px, Shift+Arrow resizes by 64px, Home moves to the minimum, and End moves to the maximum. Navigation links, work item actions, and panel toggles remain ordinary keyboard-reachable controls.
meta.responsiveConstraints: The default rail is constrained to 192-320px and the inspector to 240-420px. Below the large breakpoint the handles are hidden and panels stack so content remains readable without horizontal drag behavior.
meta.dataAttributes: Stable styling hooks use data-scope="ui-block" and data-part values for resizable-workspace-shell, workspace-header, workspace-actions, workspace-grid, left-rail, left-rail-nav, left-rail-item, resize-handle, resize-indicator, work-surface, work-list, work-item, inspector-panel, inspector-list, and inspector-item.
meta.primitiveBoundary: This block intentionally keeps resize state, pointer handling, keyboard handling, and responsive layout in UI-owned source. It does not introduce Core behavior; a future Core primitive should only be proposed if multiple generic resizable split-view needs appear across unrelated UI items.
meta.customization: Replace leftRail, workSurface, and inspector slots with app-specific source while preserving the shell data attributes and keyboard separator contract. Adjust min/max widths through props instead of editing the resize math.
meta.limitations: This is an app-layout block, not a general split-pane primitive. It does not persist panel widths, support nested split views, implement drag ghost previews, or coordinate route-level app state.

parity.shadcn: Matches shadcn-style block ownership by shipping readable copy-paste source composed from UI primitives and utility classes. Gaps: no persisted layout preferences, no app router integration, and no generated variant system.
parity.dataDenseWorkspace: Covers the reusable data-dense shell shape for a left rail, main work surface, inspector panel, keyboard-reachable actions, and responsive constraints. Gaps: terminal panes, live data orchestration, saved layouts, and specialized workspace patterns remain follow-up blocks.
parity.coreBoundary: Keeps layout composition and resize behavior in UI-owned source without adding Core exports. A general Core primitive remains deferred until repeated non-block use cases justify an ADR or RFC.
